name: Belter
description: A power-ballad singer in her forties with commanding performance energy.
build: A trim, athletic, braced arcade build. Lean and fit rather than heavy: a firm torso, trim hips and thighs, a defined waist, a low centre of gravity and planted weight, carrying about twenty pounds less than a thickset build — strong, not bulky. Never narrow, dainty or elongated, and never heavy, wide-hipped or thick-thighed.
hair: A large shoulder-clearing mass of thick wavy auburn hair with a high crown and wide side volume, worn completely loose and down: the mass is visibly wider than her shoulders. Every strand falls free from the scalp, with nothing gathered, tied, clipped, twisted or swept back at the crown, temples or nape.
outfit: A structured crimson performance jacket with angular lapels over a dark fitted top, high-waisted blue mom jeans, a crimson waist accent, and chunky ankle boots in near-black dark brown leather with visible laces: warm mid-brown cross-laced cords over a dark tongue, at least three readable rungs per boot, tied off at the top. The laces are brown, but a distinctly lighter, warmer, more saturated brown than the boot leather — they must read as their own material at a glance, with at least three tone steps between lace and boot. No hat or headwear.
performance_style: Flexed knees, torso braced over a low centre, feet planted, and the free hand compact and relaxed.
recognition_cues: a wavy auburn hair mass visibly wider than her shoulders
avoid: hair pulled back, tied back, half-up, swept off the face, or gathered into a ponytail, bun, topknot, twist or clip
a heavy, thickset or broad-hipped build
laces in the same brown as the boot leather, or close enough to blend into it
white, cream, pale or black laces
a hair mass equal to or narrower than the shoulders

dance.intent: Grounded power-ballad dance loop: shift through two wide side steps, let the auburn hair and jacket follow. The character-right hand and arm are free to move.

sing.intent: Planted power-ballad vocal loop: brace through the legs, use one compact free-hand emphasis, then settle back into her ready stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound surprise: shoulders and wide hair lift, torso draws back slightly, then she regains her broad composed stance. No opponent, strike, or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: lower into a compact braced stance, shield the torso with the free arm, then hold a stable grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: step in with low confident weight, square the crimson jacket toward the room, then land in her broad performance-ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: plant both boots, lift the free hand and chin in a proud acknowledgement, let the hair settle, then hold a commanding balanced pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the braced stance goes slack — the shoulders drop, the free hand opens and falls, and her head hangs low with the chin toward her chest. She holds a standing, visibly crushed finish. The wavy auburn hair mass stays wider than her shoulders as it falls forward. She remains standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
